name: ToolComp
description: ToolComp is a benchmark designed to evaluate multi-step tool-use reasoning by assessing both final answers and intermediate reasoning steps. It features human-edited prompts, verified answers, and process supervision labels to capture the complexity of real-world multi-tool reasoning tasks.
reputation: A recent, specialized benchmark that has started to be used in tool-use and agentic reasoning evaluations, but it is not yet a widely standardized community benchmark.
notes: Emphasizes evaluation of intermediate reasoning steps and final outcomes; developed collaboratively by models and human annotators.
